text_block_list.text:
Before the race, two unexpected visitors
come to
Найс Нэйчер's waiting room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hello, Nature. How are you feeling?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, you seem ready! I'm
excited
for today!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
McQueen! Ryan! What brings you all the
way
here?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
We had some business nearby, so we
dropped by
your race to check out the
competition.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
She's just making excuses. Honestly, we
were
worried about you.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
McQueen saw you looking pretty blue at
the
academy a little while ago.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Ryan! You promised not to mention that!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: By a little while ago, you mean...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I don't wanna run! I'm scared to run!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: It was probably around that time. Urgh...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Um, thank you for your concern, but...
I'm fine
now.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'm ready to give everything I've got to
win.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I can see it in your eyes—doubt no
longer clouds
them.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'm relieved. It's hard to be
satisfied
with a win when your rival isn't
at their best.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Rival?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
We're running at the end of the year
too!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: You mean... at the Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Hehe...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I look forward to competing with an
even
stronger version of you.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Today, we'll just be cheering you on
from the
stands! Go, Nature, go!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
McQueen and Ryan are both showing
me their
support...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
They must believe that I'll get first place
here and
go to the Arima Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
High expectations like that are a heavy
burden as
usual. But...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Leave it to me. First place will be mine!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Natieeee! Hold your head high!
text_block_list.name: Hometown Fans

text_block_list.text: Huh?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: We're here too! Go get iiiit!
text_block_list.name: Everyone from the Shopping District

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you guys too! What is this, a
National
Shopping District Association
meeting?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
With the Mejiros being here too, it's
starting to
feel like a series finale.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But it's not. It's still one step before
shining glory.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And in order to take that stЭпизод.. I have
to win!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
